en: An old sepia-toned postcard featuring a view of a river with a bridge crossing it. On either side of the river are grassy banks with trees, and on the left, there are some historic-looking buildings, possibly part of a town. Above the image are inscriptions in both Greek and French, and handwritten notes run down the right-hand margin. The dominant feature is the natural landscape with the bridge as a focal point.
